properties.description:
Anthony, 2026-09-29, in the dev_reflow2 hub session: "Fix all the root causes and go with the 7 ideas you'd promote". Source: art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29 (hub docs/TRIAL-LOG.md, Session 5, items I1–I30 and D1–D16). The root-cause facts are dated 2026-09-29 and named on each item's → line.

PACKAGES (reflow2 unless marked):
· R-A — a revise keeps what was not passed: record_finding, plan_epoch, add_change_event, with add_verification and external_dependency re-measured. Adds a class test over every "optional to revise" tool. Covers I30. Wave 1.
· R-B — decision tools: add_decision draws and echoes related_to for every kind; the hint reads the landed status; set_decision_status takes a name; the prose checks read `name`. Covers I16, the reflow2 half of I2, and I3. Wave 1.
· R-D — findings and refusals name the way through. Covers I14a, I17 (the refusal), I9, I11, I12 (the class), I13, I14b and I8. Wave 1.
· F-1 (flo2) — the gateway signs on the engine's settling fields, not a field named `status`; the reply budget is measured as the engine measured it; get_skill without a design is design-neutral; a short describe by default, and several at once. Covers the flo2 half of I2, and I5, I7 and I6. Idea 4 (flo2 half). Wave 1.
· R-E — receipts. I4, idea 3. Wave 2.
· R-F — bulk forms keep their checks. I24, idea 4. Wave 2.
· R-K — a budget declares sum or path; one read for all budgets. I18 and I17, idea 7. Wave 2.
· R-I — closure has design and build phases, and honours parking. I15, idea 5. Wave 2.
· R-G — ACTS_FOR: the agent and the principal on every write and approval; flo2 passes the calling agent. I1 and I21, idea 1. Wave 3.
· R-H — questions are addressed and answered by a named answerer in one call, and travel as a batch. I25, I29 and I28, idea 2. Wave 3, after R-G.
· R-J — derived relations are declared, checked against the code, and evaluated by a served read. I20, idea 6. Wave 3, after PR #621.
· REL — cut reflow2 v0.75.0; flo2 moves to it and deploys. Wave 4.

OUT OF SCOPE WITHOUT ANTHONY'S WORD (each root cause needs an unpromoted idea):
· I10, I23 — need D9, copies and placement.
· I22 — needs D16, re-keying.
· I26 — needs structure to carry intent status.
· I19 — a partial verification status is a schema decision.
· I27 — works as designed.

Every package: a test that fails first, observed failing; the class fixed, not the instance; regression cover (rule:every-change-to-the-built-design-carries-a-test-and-regression-cover); a ChangeEvent with repair corrected_cause, linked to its root-cause fact; one design export per PR, last.

PROGRESS AND CORRECTIONS, 2026-09-29 12:15 (hub session, mid-program). The scratch plan behind this epoch lives only in a session scratchpad, so its durable state is written here.

MERGED:
- flo2 #102 and #103 (I2 flo2 half, I5, I7, I6 plus idea 4's flo2 half). Not deployed.
- reflow2 #625, squash 42259ba (I8, I9 partly, I11, I12, I13, I14a, I14b, I17 refusal).
- reflow2 #624, squash 8588b7a (I30 class: record_finding, plan_epoch, add_change_event, and seven tools that stored name "").

IN FLIGHT:
- reflow2 #623 (I16, I2 reflow2 half, I3);
- R-K, budget composition and an all-budgets form (req:a-budget-says-whether-its-parts-add-up-or-run-along-a-path);
- R-I, design-phase closure (req:closure-reads-design-done-separately-from-build-done).

WAITING ON #623, because they touch the same reply and edge paths:
- R-E receipts;
- R-F bulk forms;
- R-S, a NEW package added after flo2 #102. flo2 signs settles from a checked copy (SETTLES), recorded as contained_symptom, because reflow2 declares nothing a program can read about which arguments settle intent. R-S makes reflow2 declare it. It also stops acknowledge_gap and acknowledge_defect minting unsigned accepted Decisions, and covers collapse_decision, which settles with no approver (fact:collapse-decision-settles-a-decision-with-no-approver-and-says-nothing-2026-09-28). flo2 then drops its copy.

WAVE 3: R-G (ACTS_FOR), R-H (addressed questions), R-J (declared derived relations). R-J is unblocked since #621 merged. Then a cut and flo2's move.

PROCESS CORRECTIONS, adopted mid-program; see fact:a-cargo-target-dir-shared-across-worktrees-linked-one-worktrees-crate-into-anothers-build-2026-09-29:
(1) A shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR mixes worktrees, so every build runs under one flock, with `cargo clean -p reflow2-core -p reflow2-mcp` inside the lock.
(2) No `git stash` in parallel worktrees.
(3) A branch's own design writes go into a worktree-private store, per fact:a-worktree-fix-recorded-its-design-changes-in-the-live-store-and-the-branch-gate-failed-2026-09-22. The live store takes only findings and ideas.

CONSEQUENCE OF (3): a merged PR's change records reach main's export but NOT the live store. So the live store's root-cause facts go on reading as open until someone closes them by hand. That is being done for #624 and #625 today. It is the gap ver:an-overlay-folds-after-a-squash-merge is meant to close; it has not yet run.

OUT OF SCOPE WITHOUT ANTHONY'S WORD: I10 and I23 (need D9, copies and where), I22 (needs D16, re-key), I26 (ratifying a set), I19 (a partial verification status is a schema decision), and the `published` reading in unconsumed_interface (D8).

PROGRESS, 2026-09-30 (hub session):
- MERGED since the last note: #628 (settling declared), #629 (draw_edges), #630 (receipts), #631 (derived relations declared) and #632 (ACTS_FOR).
- STOPPED MID-WORK when a session ended, with handoffs in the hub's scratchpad: R-S2 (generic writers; code largely written, failing-first observed), R-H (addressed questions; planned), R-J2 (the derived-check depth; started) and flo2's release prep. They are parked until Anthony's tokens reset (about 2026-10-04).
- NEW, on Anthony's word: R-S2's scope now includes the PROPER CURE for approval forgery, a signature checked where it is written. See the 2026-09-30 note on fact:root-cause-the-settle-rule-guards-the-typed-doors-and-the-generic-writers-go-around-it-2026-09-29.
- flo2 contains it meanwhile with flo2 #105, deployed 2026-09-30.
